# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
* Seasoned Senior Quality Engineering & QA Lead with over 19 years of experience driving end-to-end testing strategies, hands-on automation, and software quality across fintech, payment processing, cloud platforms, and enterprise SaaS solutions.
* Proven hands-on technical leader skilled in establishing automated testing frameworks using Playwright and Selenium, automating API regression suites, and integrating security frameworks into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
* Demonstrated track record of leading QA teams, driving transitions from manual to automated testing practices, directing cross-functional release management, and managing stakeholder alignment across complex digital migrations.

## Core Competencies & Technical Skills
* **QA Leadership & Strategy:** QA Team Leadership, End-to-End Test Strategy, Cross-Functional Release Management, Defect Triage & Prioritization, Dual BA/QA Requirements Ownership, Stakeholder Management
* **Fintech & Payment Domain:** Android Payment Terminal Architecture, Card Payment Processing & Schemes, Digital Wallets, Payment Message ISO/APACS Standards, Terminal Licensing & Onboarding Gateways
* **Test Automation & API Engineering:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Robolectric, API Gateway Regression Testing, Data Integrity Validation
* **DevOps & CI/CD Pipelines:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Automated PR Review Workflows, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF), GitHub
* **AI Tooling & Innovation:** Custom Copilot SKILL Creation, Copilot CLI, Generative AI Prompting, Dynatrace Observability
* **Languages & Frameworks:** Kotlin, Python, Java, C#, SQL, UNIX Shell Scripting, .NET, React, JavaScript, TypeScript
* **Agile Frameworks & Tools:** Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM

## Professional Experience

### Wpay (Woolworths Group) | Senior Quality Engineer
*November 2021 – Present | Sydney, Australia*
* Formulated end-to-end quality architecture, documentation, and pilot programs for a distributed Android Payment Terminal solution using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose to validate payment message structures and failure modes prior to mass market rollout.
* Developed a full end-to-end web automation test suite using Playwright covering gift card activation and redemption workflows to accelerate regression testing cycles.
* Engineered Azure DevOps pipelines to automate API Gateway regression suites and integrated Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) for static code and security vulnerability analysis across Android builds.
* Automated functional mobile testing for native iOS and Android payment applications using Android Espresso and iOS XCUITest to elevate build quality across mobile hardware.
* Utilized Generative AI tools combined with the Robolectric framework to unit test Coroutines, ViewModels, and Activities, significantly expanding automated test coverage across core payment components.
* Designed custom GitHub Copilot SKILLs for automated script generation and PR reviews, automatically identifying breaking changes and gaps in test coverage to minimize code review overhead.
* Acted in a dual Business Analyst and QA leadership capacity to define user stories, design specifications, and acceptance criteria for a terminal onboarding and licensing gateway.
* Spearheaded end-to-end testing and design feedback for an unattended EV charging payment project, ensuring release readiness and seamless payment processing.
